question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Have you ever crashed a party?

nodes.text: $ZOE leans over to listen...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't understand. I'm happy here. I don't want to mess it up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I know mistakes were made. But you can't really be serious about this good-girl act.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, Sammy. This isn't you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, now is not the time to talk about this.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're right. How about we meet at the usual place tonight?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But that's across town...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Or I could come to your place...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know what, the usual place is perfect. The farther from home, the better.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You gonna have trouble getting there? Last I checked you didn't have a license, much less a car.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Please. Just make sure you're not late.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh. Now that's the Sammy I remember.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now get out of here. I bet you don't even have a ticket to this movie.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You got me. See you later, babe.
Colt slips out of the theater...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa! That sounded serious! I wonder what's going on tonight...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, how are you holding up? Are you scared?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's... Um...
$ZOE looks back at the movie.
On the screen...

nodes.speaker: Jojo
nodes.text: I know this is hard... But I don't understand what you want from me...

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Brrraaaaiiiinnnnnssss...

nodes.speaker: Jojo
nodes.text: Aggghhh!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aww... Don't be scared.
Howard pulls $ZOE close.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe zombie movies aren't `all` bad...
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe zombie movies aren't [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] bad...

nodes.text: A couple hours later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so worried about Sam, I'm never going to get to sleep without some warm milk.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I should see if she's up...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam's always so guarded, but maybe I'm just not catching her at the right time...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe now's the perfect time for some girl talk...
$ZOE pushes open the door to Sam's room and finds...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sneaking out! What's it look like?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... Sneaking out... That's not like you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't know what I'm like.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But `I` know that `you're` too much of a goody-goody to follow me...
nodes.text_bbcode: But [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] know that [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] too much of a goody-goody to follow me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I know you're too good of a friend to tell my mom.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So look, I'll be back in a few hours, okay? Don't worry. Just go back to sleep and forget you ever saw this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: See you later, $ZOE.
Sam climbs out the window!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam...
$ZOE hears a beep from Sam's computer! She looks over and sees an instant message up on Sam's laptop.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam's message log! Let's see where she's going...
$ZOE scrolls up...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Meet me at the party tonight at 424 Storey Street.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't let her do this. I've got to stop her...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But if I'm going out late at night, I shouldn't go alone. Besides, I'll probably need help...
$ZOE grabs her phone and calls Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard? Sorry, I know it's late, but... How do you feel about going to a party tonight?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, you wouldn't understand...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt and I... We have unfinished business. When he got sent off to boot camp, we were still together...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's nice of you to worry about me... But this is something I have to take care of myself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... Okay. But you should know that I'm here if you need me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No offense, but I don't think this is something you could really deal with.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You sound exactly like my mom.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She thinks he's a bad influence... And she's right. He got me into tons of trouble at my last school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I guess you should avoid him, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, $ZOE, give me a break! I mean, I get it! Everyone hates him! I should stay away from him!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But it's not always that simple, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, okay. Sorry I brought it up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, I didn't mean to snap at you. Just leave it alone, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's something I've got to ask you...

nodes.prompt: Sam, there's something I've got to ask you...

options.label: Why were you talking to Colt?
Doesn't Colt seem like a bad guy?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Sam, there's something I've got to ask you...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Well, that's probably not the only reason. Samantha never really had many friends there.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Maybe that was part of the problem. Monarch Prep was an all girls boarding school.
Sam's mom points to a picture of Sam taped to the fridge that shows her scowling in a white collared shirt and a blue plaid skirt.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: I think the girls there weren't very nice. Samantha was only close to a few of them.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: She's so much happier now.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Well, it looks like all the dishes are done. Thanks for helping me, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course. Good night, Aunt Cathy.
$ZOE heads to Sam's room...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Sam? Can I talk to you for a second?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nothing big... I was just thinking about that guy we saw tonight...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah? What about him?

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Her ex-boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, that guy named Colt.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Well, Samantha doesn't like to talk about that...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: But I don't know why. Honestly, I'm really proud of her! I mean, I'm proud she managed to turn her life around.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What exactly happened?

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Well, Samantha started getting into a bad crowd... She got into some trouble with Principal Whitford... That was the Principal at her old school.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: When Samantha got to Centerscore High, she was determined to start over... And she really did!

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Since she started there, she hasn't gotten into any trouble at all.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh. Is that why Sam never talks about...

nodes.prompt: Is that why Sam never talks about...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Is that why Sam never talks about...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just... A... Little... Farther...
$ZOE suddenly loses her balance, falling into Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa!
Howard's popcorn and soda go flying, straight into the people in front of them!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey! What's the big idea?!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Uck. It's everywhere...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry! Sorry!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Is there a problem over here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Skazz? You work here?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: That's right... And if you're causing a disturbance, I've got to throw you out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, wait a second!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Travis! I need some backup here! We've got some rowdy customers.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Why can't people just watch the movie?!
Travis and Skazz throw $ZOE and Howard out of the theater!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Howard...
A couple hours later...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, hope you didn't mind waiting... I `had` to see that movie.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, hope you didn't mind waiting... I [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] to see that movie.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. But can we go home now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure, of course.
On the screen...

nodes.speaker: Jojo
nodes.text: Okay, so, I know last time, you said you couldn't be with me...

nodes.speaker: Jojo
nodes.text: But I'm pretty sure you're in love with me. Maybe we should just make out a little...

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Oh, Jojo... I `do` love you... But I'm not sure I love you `enough` to leave everything behind...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, Jojo... I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] love you... But I'm not sure I love you [color=#3b78e2][i]enough[/i][/color] to leave everything behind...

nodes.speaker: Jojo
nodes.text: Hang on a second, is that a zombie behind you?!

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Eeeek!
Just then, someone sits down next to Sam!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Sammy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt?! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You never could pass up a good blood-and-guts zombie movie on opening night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's going on with this guy? How does he know Sam?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is just like old times, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, it is most definitely `not` like old times!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, it is most definitely [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] like old times!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Shh!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah, quiet over there! Some of us are trying to watch the movie!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So watch the movie!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt! Keep your voice down!
Sam leans over towards Colt and starts whispering...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't quite hear them... Maybe if I lean over a little bit...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, no problem! I can handle it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um, really? 'Cause you're shaking...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Boo!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eek!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Howard, those are ghosts. Zombies are more like agggghhhh... gggnggghhh...
Sam grabs $ZOE's arm.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Aaarrmmmmm...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Stop stop stop stop! Okay! I'm scared!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, sorry, $ZOE. I didn't know you were really getting freaked out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe we should go to another movie?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's crazy! Besides, it's too late now! The movie's starting!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, to tell you the truth, I'm totally terrified.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Should we leave?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Sam really wants to see the movie. And we already bought tickets.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll just... Um... Be over in the corner quietly hyperventilating.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aw, come over here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll keep you safe.
Howard gives $ZOE a kiss!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee! You don't think I'm a total wimp for being scared?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nah, I think it's really cute. Besides, it gives me an excuse to keep my arm around you for the whole movie...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, okay. Break it up, you two! The movie's starting!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not his little sister! I'm his girlfriend! And you keep your hands off of him!
$ZOE grabs Howard and kisses him!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mhhmmm...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mmmm...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Ugh, okay, I guess he's taken.

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Yeah, you can ease up now, kid.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It worked!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh? Oh! Right. It worked!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Just who are you, anyway? I don't recognize you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right. What should we do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's wait and see where this is going.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... But if things get out of hand, I'm jumping in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, he acts like he's above what everyone thinks about him...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that really just means that he acts like a selfish jerk.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: People like that are totally inconsiderate.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh, right.
Howard gives $ZOE a kiss on her cheek.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What was that for?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's just nice to know that I don't have to worry about you leaving me for some bad boy like Linda did.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha! Are you serious? There's no `way` I'd go for a guy like that.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha! Are you serious? There's no [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] I'd go for a guy like that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, it's just nice to hear. Anyway, let's focus on Sam. I don't want to get too distracted.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, I wish `I` didn't care about what other people think of me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, I wish [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] didn't care about what other people think of me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Breakin' rules, doing whatever you feel like doing... It must be pretty fun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, really? I guess I didn't figure you'd go for the whole bad boy thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's kind of fun, don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I never really understood it. I didn't really get what Linda saw in Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep! I forgot Linda broke up with Howard for a bad boy... Yikes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, that's not what I...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, forget it. Let's just focus on Sam, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where'd Sam go?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There! She's getting into that car over there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks for giving me a ride, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, sure. I owed you one. But now we're even for the key lime pie incident.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha. Fine.
The two girls hop into a sleek convertible and drive off!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Looks like we're headed somewhere else...
Howard and $ZOE follow Sam across town...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't get it... Colt wasn't even at the party...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe Sam only came to the party to get a ride from that girl.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course! She must be meeting Colt some place far away... So I guess she needed someone with a car...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And someone who owed her a favor.
After another half an hour of driving...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, look, they're pulling over...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you sure you don't need a ride back?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm sure Colt can give me a lift back to my side of town.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay. See you later.
Paige waves at Sam and jumps back in her car. Sam heads into the park as Paige pulls away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hurry! We have to catch up to her!
$ZOE and Howard get closer and spot Sam sitting on a bench.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's she doing?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think she's waiting...
Just then, there's a roar of an engine as Colt, on his motorcycle, tears into the park.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Sammy. Sorry I'm late.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You always did like to make an entrance.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, man. That guy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha. I think I know what you're getting at. Colt is totally...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Um, so what? We go to an all girls school. There are girls fighting `all` the time.
nodes.text_bbcode: Um, so what? We go to an all girls school. There are girls fighting [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] the time.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, $ZOE. I think a girl-fight isn't the best way to appeal to a crowd of girls...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I forgot there weren't any guys here... Ugh! We'll just have to push our way through the crowd...
$ZOE and Howard dive into the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ouch! Oof! We've got to get through...
$ZOE gets dragged under the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE? Where are you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Getting stepped on! Oww! Help!
Howard reaches down and pulls $ZOE up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel like I just got trampled by a herd of livestock...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, don't give up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're right. Ugh, we've got to keep going...
After a few minutes of elbowing through the mass of people...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: The cops?! I can't get expelled!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: My parents will `kill` me if they find out I was at a party!
nodes.text_bbcode: My parents will [color=#3b78e2][i]kill[/i][/color] me if they find out I was at a party!

nodes.text: Everyone panics and runs!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Perfect. Looks like we've got our way out!
Outside the party...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second... Isn't that her heading out the door?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?! But we just got here! Why's she leaving? I haven't even `seen` Colt here...
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! But we just got here! Why's she leaving? I haven't even [color=#3b78e2][i]seen[/i][/color] Colt here...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We can figure out why later... Right now we need to follow her before we lose her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But there's too much of a crowd between us and her... We've got to clear the room out...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How are we going to clear out this whole party?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've got an idea...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey! Everyone! Listen up!

nodes.prompt: (What should I say to clear the room?)

options.label: There are two girls fighting outside!

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: (What should I say to clear the room?)

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Huh? Who's that?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: How pathetic, she doesn't even know who our principal is. No way she goes here.

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Time to leave, little girl.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gulp...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, stop right there. No one's laying a hand on $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Oh, please. Wouldn't you rather party with us?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! Look, we'll get out of your way, but no one's messing with $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Okay, okay!
Howard grabs $ZOE's hand and pulls her across the room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was a close one. Thanks for bailing me out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No problem.

nodes.text: What?! No way! You wouldn't do that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just try me!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Fiiiine. We'll leave you alone. But you better not make any trouble, kid.
Prissy, Penelope, and Caroline leave $ZOE and Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nice, how'd you know the principal's name?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have my sources...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, it really saved us some trouble.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, but we still haven't found Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, if you mess with me, I'll call Principal... Um...

nodes.text: Gotcha! You're wrong!

nodes.text: That's right...

nodes.speaker: Prissy

Penelope kisses Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mmmphhh!
Howard pushes her away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I tried to tell you, I...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: He's clearly not into you, Penny.
Prissy grabs Howard and kisses him!

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Hey, don't be selfish!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Grr... Get away from my boyfriend!
$ZOE pulls Howard away from Prissy, sending him flying into the snack table!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Hey! That platter is real imported crystal! Watch it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `You` watch it! Stop manhandling my boyfriend!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You[/i][/color] watch it! Stop manhandling my boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's right! You need to stay off of me.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Fine, fine.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You're no fun at all.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you okay, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yuck... I'm covered in strawberry lemonade and pretzels...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, at least you're not covered in any more kisses.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe those girls got their lips on you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes. That was... Terrible.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I hope you're planning on paying for all those snacks, kid.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Just who are you, anyway? You don't look familiar.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, so we're crashing a party?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've got to help Sam. I just don't want this Colt guy to get her into trouble.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, hop in. Let's go find this place.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know, this place is really close to your house. It shouldn't take us long to get there.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess I could've walked... But I really could use some back up tonight.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, of course. What kind of boyfriend would turn down the chance to sneak his girl out of the house to go to a party?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee...
A few minutes later, Howard and $ZOE pull up to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's... A boarding school dorm?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Yes. Yes it is.
$ZOE and Howard walk up to the front door and see a group of girls standing outside. One comes up to Howard...

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Hey! A boy! Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um, hey! Good to see you. Have a fun night.
$ZOE and Howard start to walk by...

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Wait a second, cutie... You're welcome to come in...

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: But we don't need any more girls.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! $ZOE is my girlfriend! I'm not leaving her side tonight!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww! Howard!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Ugh, fiiine. The one guy here `would` bring his girlfriend.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, fiiine. The one guy here [color=#3b78e2][i]would[/i][/color] bring his girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: I guess we should be happy `any` guy showed up here. That's what we get for having a party on a school night.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess we should be happy [color=#3b78e2][i]any[/i][/color] guy showed up here. That's what we get for having a party on a school night.

nodes.text: As soon as Howard and $ZOE walk into the room, all the girls turn to Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, that girl wasn't kidding... Howard, I think you're the only boy here...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: A `boy!`
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]boy![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: And I thought this night would be a total waste!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa! These girls are getting a little too close to Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, girls, I...

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Shhh! You don't need to say anything, cutie. Have you ever been to Tahiti? My parents own a little island near it...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Please, Tahiti is so last year. `My` parents own a yacht that will take us `anywhere...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Please, Tahiti is so last year. [color=#3b78e2][i]My[/i][/color] parents own a yacht that will take us [color=#3b78e2][i]anywhere...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, wait a minute...
Prissy pushes $ZOE aside.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: But next time you come, leave your little sister at home, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Little sister?! That's it... I need to get these girls to back off!

nodes.prompt: Get the girls to back off!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.text: Colt puts his arm around Sam and pulls her close.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, not here. I want to get out of this town, Colt. Take me away from here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure, babe. Where do you want to go?
Sam grabs Colt's hand and pulls him up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey! Not so fast!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa, you brought your cousin?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't bring her! She must have followed me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad I did! You're about to make a huge mistake!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh really? And what mistake is that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... I mean... You're about to get back together with Colt... And that would be a terrible decision!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You think so? Well, sometimes you have to learn that you can't control other people's lives!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, Colt. Let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Awesome. Where are we going?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Vegas. Now.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... Cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't take these rules anymore! I've tried to be good, but I can't do it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, we're eloping.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Huh?! We are?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes! We'll never come home. We'll live off of buffets and our poker winnings. We'll go from hotel to hotel, each more opulent than the last! Get on your bike!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, sure... I guess that sounds pretty good...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Wait! Stop!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go live your own life, $ZOE. I'm tired of you trying to tell me how to live mine.
Sam and Colt ride off!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That... Could have gone better.
Sam heading off to Vegas to marry Colt?! This can't be the right ending!
If only you'd played a little better... Things could have been a lot different!
Try again and get a better ending for $ZOE and Sam!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: As $ZOE and Howard watch from the shadows, Colt sits down on the bench next to Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come here, Sammy...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You know, this party is on a closed campus. That means we can kick you out if you don't go here... And I'm pretty sure I would know if you went here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You just haven't seen me around. I started here last week!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Oh yeah? And where is 'here'? Do you even know the name of this school?

nodes.prompt: What was the name of Sam's old school?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What was the name of Sam's old school?

nodes.text: After Howard drops Sam and $ZOE off at their house...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Hi, girls. How was the movie?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It was amazing! I really felt like they were developing the themes of the inevitability of death and the precious nature of life...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And of course the special effects of the heads exploding were also cool.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Ha ha. That's my Samantha...
Sam gives her mom a hug.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: $ZOE? What did you think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Zombie movies aren't really my thing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Aw, come on. Are you really worried someone will try to eat your brrraaaaiiiinnnssss?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Heh heh. Well, I think I'll turn in early. Good night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wonder what was going on with Sam and Colt... Maybe Sam's mom knows something. I guess it couldn't hurt to ask.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: What about you, $ZOE? Are you heading off to sleep?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nah, I'm not tired yet. Let me help you with those dishes.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Aw, thank you, sweetie! I'm so happy you and Samantha are getting along these days.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! Sam really looks out for me... And I try to look out for her too. Actually, I had something I wanted to ask you...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Sure. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam never talks about the past... So I wanted to ask you about...

nodes.prompt: I wanted to ask you about...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I wanted to ask you about...

nodes.text: Want to catch up? Check out The New Girl Mega Pack to meet $ZOE! Or grab the Season One Set, now available in our store at 50% off!

nodes.title: Party Crashers
nodes.subtitle: Sometimes you have to crash a party to solve a mystery...

nodes.text: Welcome back to Centerscore High! Today, you'll be playing as $ZOE. She, Howard, and Sam are heading to the movies...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, thanks for driving us to the theater.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I've been `dying` to see this movie.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I've been [color=#3b78e2][i]dying[/i][/color] to see this movie.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: By the way, thanks for letting me crash your date tonight.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't worry about it. I'm still surprised Aunt Cathy let us go on a school night!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Heh, she knows how much I love the mid-week blockbuster releases.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, look at that crowd up there! We'd better get moving if we want good seats.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right! Let's go!
Inside the theater...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sooo excited.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, what are we seeing again?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'A Midsummer Night of the Living Undead'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So is that some kind of classic adaptation?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, if by 'adaptation' you mean 'instead of boring Victorian stuff there are zombies'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `WHAT?` Zombies?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]WHAT?[/i][/color] Zombies?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you okay, $ZOE? Is the movie going to be too scary for you?

nodes.prompt: Is the movie going to be too scary for you?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Is the movie going to be too scary for you?

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Colt?! How do you know `him?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt?! How do you know [color=#3b78e2][i]him?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um, well, he showed up at the movie today...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: He went to the movie with you?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, not exactly! He just showed up! I mean, it wasn't like we...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Excuse me, $ZOE. I need to go have a word with Samantha.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gulp...
$ZOE hears shouting coming from Sam's room...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep! Sounds like I just got Sam into some big trouble with her mom...
A few minutes later, after the shouting dies down, $ZOE knocks on Sam's door and goes into Sam's room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Sam. Sorry about earlier...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks a lot. My mom grounded me for a week... And I didn't even do anything!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I tried to tell her...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, save it. I know you didn't mean it. I guess I should have explained it to you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That Colt guy? You already know that he and I have history together...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I should have warned you that my mom `hates` him.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I should have warned you that my mom [color=#3b78e2][i]hates[/i][/color] him.

Colt puts his arm around Sam and pulls her close, but she pushes him away!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey! Stop it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's wrong? Isn't this what you wanted?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Look, Colt... I tried to tell you... Things are different here. I'm different here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know we had something great... But that was in the past.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've got a good life here now. I'm a cheerleader. I'm getting good grades. My mom's actually proud of me. And I can't risk losing that. I won't.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?! You're saying...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't be your girlfriend, Colt. We can't do this.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't get it. So why'd you even come out here tonight?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because I really cared about you, you idiot! You were the most important person in my life!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And saying good bye to you was one of the hardest things I've ever done...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And because now that we're not going to be together... Well, I thought you deserved to hear it in person, just the two of us.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You can't be serious.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm starting a new life... And we both know that you're nothing but trouble. I mean, I heard about why you got thrown into boot camp...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You shouldn't believe everything you hear. Never figured you to buy into gossip.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's pretty persuasive when you also read it in the newspaper.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So that's it? We just forget about each other? Fine. Let's do it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Please, Colt. Don't be mad. I... I didn't want tonight to be like this.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How did you want it to be? You're running away and taking the easy way out, and I'm just supposed to...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm starting over, okay? I have to! And that means I can't have you as a boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You can't just forget about us! We have history!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want you in my history! Just forget you ever knew me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Great, what a waste of a night. I'm out of here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay. Fine. Let's go.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where do you think you're going?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Aren't you... I need a ride back...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're not going anywhere with me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But... We're in the middle of nowhere! Okay, I admit, this talk didn't go as well as I thought it would...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I get that you're mad... But how am I supposed to get home?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, you see that? That's exactly the kind of thing I'd have to worry about if I were your boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Or even your friend.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Or even your past.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I'm nothing to you, right Sammy?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not what I...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whatever. Later.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You can't just leave me here! It's going to take me all night to walk back!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then you better get walking.
Colt revs up his motorcycle and drives off!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Jerk...
Sam turns to start walking home, but $ZOE and Howard step out of the shadows...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Hey, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE?! Howard? What are you two doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, we followed you to stop you from making a huge mistake...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it looks like you can take care of yourself.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, except for that getting home part. I'll take care of that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know, I guess I should be mad that you followed me... But I'm actually pretty impressed.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: My goody-goody cousin actually snuck out after curfew... She's afraid of zombies, but she'll come out to a park in the middle of the night...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you're not mad?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's pretty hard to argue with a ride home right now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee... Glad we could help.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam? Are you okay?
Sam gives $ZOE a tight hug.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just... You came all the way out here on a school night... For me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've just... It's just...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nevermind. I'm just glad we're friends, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Okay. Come on. You've had a long day. Let's go home.
Awww! It's not every day that Sam shows some real emotion.
But at least she's got her cousin with her, and all because you played a great game!

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: In fact, you played a perfect game! And you know what that means...
For this bonus scene, we're going back in time to when Sam first started at Monarch Prep...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Okay, Samantha, it looks like that's the last of your bags. Take care of yourself, sweetie! We'll see you in a few weeks when we come to visit.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Bye, Mom...
As Sam's mom drives away, Sam picks up her duffle bag and starts walking up to Monarch Prep's dormitory where a crowd of girls are waiting to move in...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Hey, I'm Penelope. I'm new here, too.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sam. Nice to meet you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hmm... Last season's jeans and grungy tennis shoes? Looks like someone's here on scholarship.

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Ha ha! You can always spot the freebies, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Whoa, what's your problem?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just calling it like I see it. I wouldn't want to be associating with the wrong crowd.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Some of us don't need to spend thousands of dollars to look good.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Riiight, let me guess. You've been slumming it in public school your whole life where that kind of look is totally hipster?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Or maybe you're what passed for pretty back at whatever discount store public school you came from.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, newsflash. Monarch Prep is a private school. Girls here actually know what fashion is.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Hey, we have to wear uniforms here. Besides, maybe she just wore this while she's moving in. Who wants to mess up their nice clothes?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Please. I wouldn't use this girl's shirt as a dust rag.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? Have you got something to say for yourself?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, just because I don't waste all of my time shopping...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. I'm out of here.
Yikes! It looks like boarding school is a rough place... Even for someone like Sam!
But maybe that explains a little more about where she picked up her sharp temper.
How does Sam end up being friends with Paige? Why is Penelope so friendly?
But we'll be showing you more about Sam's secret life at boarding school next week in a very special flashback episode!
See you next time!
While you wait for the next episode...
Don't forget to check out the cool Surviving High School themed items available in the Pet Society Facebook game and play Pet Society for FREE on Facebook!
Colt puts his arm around Sam and pulls her close.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sammy, I... I...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I've got a confession to make.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, the real reason I asked you to come out here tonight...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is because I knew your cousin, $ZOE, would follow you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh?
Colt walks over to where $ZOE and Howard are hiding in the shadows.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, babe, you need to ditch the square and get with a winner.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is this, the 1950's?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let me ask you something... Has this joker ever taken the death spiral curve on Dead Man's Pass at eighty miles an hour?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, I guess not...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Has he ever gotten into a fight with a vending machine over the last bag of chips?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you `talking` about?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you [color=#3b78e2][i]talking[/i][/color] about?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My point is, this guy hasn't `lived.` He can't show you the world, $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: My point is, this guy hasn't [color=#e23b3b][i]lived.[/i][/color] He can't show you the world, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I can.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come with me, and I'll show you a whole different side of life.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I... I could never...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You already snuck out of the house after curfew. You got into a party. And you came all the way out to 'Make Out Park' on a Wednesday night!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I... I guess you're right!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay! I'll do it! Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! What're you saying?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Being bad's just too much fun!
$ZOE and Colt hop on Colt's motorcycle.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now... That... Is... Surprising.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Tell me about it.
